newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mid-Atlantic spot power rises on gas, weather.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mid-Atlantic spot power rises on gas, weather.

text.p: Spot bulk electricity prices in the Mid-Atlantic U.S. rose Friday on higher natural gas prices and anticipation of a cold front next week, which would create heating demand.
"It's gas plus a little colder weather next week," an East Coast broker said.

The latest forecasts showed the midsection of the Atlantic seaboard would continue to enjoy spring-like weather through this weekend. Saturday temperatures would peak in a 50-60 degree Fahrenheit range and bottom in the 30s-40s, about 12-16 degree above seasonal average.
